title: .mcyc routine file
description: CURRENT version, tracking the latest .mcyc format (2.6 today). This document may gain fields as the format grows; pin https://minicycle.app/schema/mcyc-2.6.schema.json instead if you need validation results that never shift. A miniCycle routine: a named, ordered list of tasks that resets and repeats. Plain JSON, UTF-8, no compression. This schema describes what the miniCycle importer ACCEPTS: a file that validates here will import. Fields marked 'derived' are recomputed by the app on load; authoring them has no durable effect.

name.description: REQUIRED. A stable identifier for the routine. The importer rejects any file where this is missing or empty, even if 'title' is present. Convention is lowercase with underscores (morning_routine).

title.description: Display name shown in the app, and where emoji belong. Optional: the app falls back to 'name'. Resolution order is title -> name -> "Routine".

tasks.description: REQUIRED, and must be an array (an empty array is valid). Order is meaningful: it is the order tasks appear. Files with more than 150 tasks are TRUNCATED to the first 150 on import, not rejected.

autoReset.description: Auto mode: the routine resets itself once every task is checked. NOTE the default: omitting this field produces an AUTO routine, because the importer reads it as (autoReset !== false). Set it to false explicitly for a manual routine.

deleteCheckedTasks.description: To-Do mode: completed tasks are removed rather than reset. Takes precedence over autoReset when both are true.

cycleCount.description: How many times the routine has been completed. Ship shared templates with 0.

theme.description: Vocabulary theme identifier. Unknown values fall back to the default theme rather than failing the import.

recurringTemplates.description: Optional map keyed by task id. Usually omit this: the importer DERIVES a template for every task with recurring:true, and merges anything supplied here on top.

task.description: A single task. No field is strictly required (the importer generates a missing id, coerces non-string text, and fills every flag), but 'text' is what the user reads, so always supply it. Unknown properties are DROPPED on import (the importer copies a fixed field set), so custom metadata will not survive a round trip.

id.description: Unique within the file. Generated as task-<timestamp>-<index> if absent. Must be unique: duplicate ids make find-by-id resolve to the first match and can drop a task on reorder.

text.description: The task text the user reads. Emoji are supported.

highPriority.description: Format 2.5 spelling, still accepted: a flagged task is read as level 'high' unless priorityColor names another level. Exporters wrote it beside 'priority' for older readers from Sep 19 to Oct 13 2026 and no longer do. Prefer 'priority'.

priorityColor.description: Format 2.5 spelling, still accepted: a swatch colour of any theme names its level, any other hex its colour family. Ignored unless highPriority is true, and ignored entirely when 'priority' is present. Prefer 'priority'.

dueDate.description: ISO 8601 date string, or null. Invalid dates are discarded rather than failing the import.

recurring.description: Marks the task as scheduled. Setting this also changes the default for deleteWhenCompleteSettings; see that field.

deleteWhenCompleteSettings.description: Format 2.5 spelling of 'autoClear', still accepted; ignored when 'autoClear' is present. Prefer 'autoClear'.

deleteWhenComplete.description: Format 2.5 DERIVED mirror; ignored on import since 2.6. Do not author it. Exporters wrote it for older readers until Oct 13 2026 and no longer do.

schemaVersion.description: Task schema version. Optional; the importer sets it to 2.

priority.description: Priority LEVEL (format 2.6). The app shows it as the active theme's colour for that level; no colour is stored. null means no priority. When both this and the 2.5 pair (highPriority + priorityColor) are present, this field wins.

deleteWhenCompleteSettings.description: Whether the task is REMOVED (rather than just unchecked) when the routine resets or completed tasks are cleared. Held per mode, because the sensible answer differs between them. This is the durable field; 'deleteWhenComplete' is derived from it.

cycle.description: Applies in Auto and Manual modes. Default depends on the task: TRUE for recurring tasks (the occurrence is removed and the schedule brings it back) and FALSE for ordinary tasks (they are unchecked and stay). Set false on a recurring task to keep it permanently visible.

todo.description: Applies in To-Do mode, where 'Clear Completed' removes finished tasks. Defaults to TRUE for every task. Note that To-Do mode does delete recurring tasks, and the schedule re-adds them; only the archive and the achievement counter exclude them.

recurringSettings.description: Schedule for a task with recurring:true. The sub-object matching 'frequency' is read. Invalid values are normalized rather than rejected, so an unrecognized value will not fail the import; it will simply not schedule the way you intended. Until Nov 2026 this schema (and the pinned 2.5 / 2.6 files) named some fields differently from the app: repeatCount, daily.time, monthly.dayOfMonth, monthly.nthWeekday and monthly.weekday. Those names are still accepted on import (marked deprecated below); write the current names.

indefinitely.description: Repeat forever. When false, count (or untilDate) bounds it.

count.description: Number of occurrences when indefinitely is false.

repeatCount.description: Former name of count, accepted on import when count is absent.

untilDate.description: Last day to recur, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). No occurrence is scheduled after it.

time.description: Time of day for the occurrence, 12-hour. Used by daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, yearly and specific dates (hourly uses hourly.minute instead).

military.description: Written by older versions; false means hour is 12-hour with meridiem.

useSpecificTime.description: Whether 'time' is set. The importer sets it when a file gives a time without it.

useSpecificMinute.description: Recur at 'minute' past each hour; otherwise each hour from when it was set up.

daily.description: Holds only the former daily.time; daily tasks use the top-level 'time'.

time.description: Former 24-hour HH:MM form of the time, accepted on import when the top-level 'time' is absent.

days.description: Days of the week to recur on.

referenceDate.description: A date in week 1 (ISO 8601); weeks alternate from it.

monthly.description: Either specific days of the month (useSpecificDays + days and/or lastDay) or a week-of-month pattern (useWeekOfMonth + weekOfMonth, e.g. the 2nd Tuesday).

days.description: Days of the month to recur on.

lastDay.description: Also recur on the last day of each month.

dayOfMonth.description: Former name, accepted on import as days: [dayOfMonth] when no current monthly field is set.

nthWeekday.description: Former name, accepted on import with 'weekday' as weekOfMonth: 1-4 for 1st-4th, 5 or -1 for the last.

weekday.description: Former name, the weekday for nthWeekday (Sun-Sat).

applyDaysToAll.description: Use daysByMonth.all for every month; otherwise daysByMonth per month number.

autoClear.description: Whether the task is REMOVED (rather than just unchecked) when the routine resets or completed tasks are cleared, held per mode (format 2.6). An OPEN map: a mode a later version adds is carried as a boolean under its own key. When both this and the 2.5 'deleteWhenCompleteSettings' are present, this field wins.

cycle.description: Applies in Auto and Manual mode (Clear on Reset). Default false: the task is kept and unchecked.

todo.description: Applies in To-Do mode (Marked for Clearing). Default true: the task is removed.
